headline: Quarterly growth was mixed, with a few firms posting strong AI‑driven gains while others saw modest top‑line expansion.
summary: Coforge led revenue growth with a 53.6% YoY jump and raised its EBIT margin guidance. HCLTech and TCS delivered solid profit expansion supported by AI revenue. Infosys and Wipro posted the weakest top‑line growth, and Wipro's profit fell YoY. Overall, AI‑led contracts are becoming a key driver across the sector.

themes.title: AI‑led revenue acceleration
themes.detail: Several firms highlighted double‑digit AI revenue growth, boosting margins and deal wins.

themes.title: Margin guidance shifts
themes.detail: Coforge raised its EBIT margin target, while Infosys trimmed FY27 revenue guidance.

themes.title: Dividend consistency
themes.detail: Most companies maintained or modestly increased interim dividends.
